text:
maya (Design): Quick review: compact scrubber + a tiny 'Sampled' affordance. Goal: reduce chip clutter and make sampled state discoverable. Proto: https://redwood.design/proto/compact-scrub-v4

dez (Frontend): Are we targeting narrow panels or mobile? Implementation differs.

maya (Design): Narrow panels first (420px-ish), mobile later. Idea: collapse p95 pill to icon+abbr, show full text on hover/focus.

kiran (Observability): We need to show sample ratio somewhere. Customers confused when p95 changes on zoom.

ops-bot: Staging note: recent heatmap changes increased CPU on integrated GPUs. Watch perf.

rachel (A11y): Accessibility: color-only indicators won't fly. Provide tooltip text + optional pattern overlay for high-contrast mode. Ensure aria-live updates when async job queued.

dez (Frontend): Technical approach: icon chip with aria-label="p95 120ms, sampled (1:10)". Click opens small panel: ratio + "Compute exact p95" CTA. Keyboard: focus then press S opens panel.

sam_ops: Backend: full compute is async. API: POST /compute-full-p95 -> {job_id, eta}. Rate-limit: 30/min/org. Cache recent full results for 10m.

maya (Design): Copy proposal: chip: "Sampled" tooltip: "Estimated from sampled traces (1 in 10). Request exact computation." Button: "Compute exact p95"

rachel (A11y): For patterns: hatch/dots at low opacity. Expose toggle in user settings. Provide text legend and ARIA description.

kiran (Observability): Log actions: range, sample ratio, compute requested, job duration, p95 delta. QA should include a case where sample ratio is 1:1 (no sampling).

dez (Frontend): I'll prototype icon chip + panel. I'll try SVG overlay for high-contrast to avoid extra canvas draws.

maya (Design): Agreed sprint decision: compact icon chip under 420px, label "Sampled" otherwise; panel with ratio + async CTA; optional pattern overlay via settings/high-contrast. Next: dez prototype, sam_ops API spec, rachel a11y checks.

sam_ops: Will draft API and include guardrails.

rachel (A11y): I'll run keyboard and contrast tests once prototype lands.

maya (Design): Thanks — keep thread updated with prototypes/comments. :sparkles:
